title: 第18章 果真是扶不起的纨绔
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
“陛下今日在宝库门前，对梦妃妹妹说的那番话，可真够绝情的呢～”

    “臣妾听着都替梦妃妹妹心疼。”

    秦然懒洋洋地靠在夜弦月身上，舒服地闭着双眸。

    “梦妃想把朕当个呼之即来的傀儡，朕平日心情好时，陪她玩玩倒也无妨，但现在，朕没心情了。”

    “怎么？爱妃觉得朕做的不对？”

    夜弦月柔声一笑，俯身凑到他耳畔，呵气如兰。

    “臣妾哪敢～只是有些好奇，若过些日子梦妃妹妹放下姿态前来求情，陛下您会心软吗？”

    秦然不屑一笑，眼中尽是嘲讽。

    “朕的深情又不是路边野狗，扔块肉就去摇尾巴，有些深情，错过了便就没了……”

    说着，秦然抬手捏了捏夜弦月的柔嫩脸颊，颇有些责怪。

    “爱妃别提她了，扫兴。”

    夜弦月顺势握住了秦然的手，媚眼中带着几分幽怨之色。

    “好好好，陛下不喜欢，臣妾不提便是了。”

    “那陛下接下来准备将宠幸赠于哪位妹妹呢，香香妹妹？还是大夏第一美的观观妹妹？”

    “若陛下有了决断，一定提早告诉臣妾，臣妾也好备上礼物提前当做贺礼～～”

    这番话说的酸溜溜的。

    秦然心中暗笑，随手将一个精致盒子丢在了夜弦月怀里。

    “爱妃说的极是，确实得备上些贺礼，免得日后被其他爱妃穿小鞋。”

    “爱妃看看，这盒中之物能否当做贺礼？”

    夜弦月疑惑地将盒子打开。

    顿时，一股直入灵魂的暖意弥漫开来，寝宫中的寒气都被驱散了几分。

    “这是……”

    夜弦月目不转睛地盯着盒中玉佩，娇躯轻颤，紫眸中荡漾出无限柔和。

    秦然轻浮一笑，“这是凰魂暖玉，自带一丝火凰真魂，可驱散世间冰寒。”

    “爱妃觉得，这块玉当做贺礼如何？”

    夜弦月将玉佩紧紧握在手中，不满地白了秦然一眼。

    “这块玉是臣妾的～”

    “哦。”

    秦然玩味一笑。

    夜弦月把玩着玉佩，周围弥漫着一股暖意，冰凉的脸蛋都红润了几分。

    她将玉佩轻轻贴在胸口，沉默片刻后，妖异紫眸中多了一抹罕见的认真。

    “陛下，您有没有想过潜心修炼，重现帝族云家荣光？”

    秦然闻声心里一震。

    这几天的努力果然没白费，夜弦月的提示已经表现出其态度的转变。
content_en:
"The words His Majesty said to Sister Meng Fei in front of the treasure house today were so heartless~"

    "I feel sorry for my sister Meng Fei when I hear this."

    Qin Ran leaned lazily against Ye Xianyue and closed his eyes comfortably.

    "Concubine Meng wants to treat me as a puppet who can come whenever she wants. When I'm usually in a good mood, it's okay to play with her, but now, I'm not in the mood."

    "What? Concubine, do you think I did something wrong?"

    Ye Xianyue smiled softly, leaned over to his ear, and breathed like a blue.

    "How dare I, my concubine! I'm just a little curious. If Sister Mengfei lowers her attitude and comes to plead for mercy in a few days, will your Majesty be soft-hearted?"

    Qin Ran smiled disdainfully, his eyes full of ridicule.

    "My affection is not like that of a wild dog on the roadside. I throw a piece of meat and wag its tail. I am somewhat affectionate. If I miss it, it will be gone..."

    After saying that, Qin Ran raised his hand and pinched Ye Xianyue's tender cheek, feeling quite reproachful.

    "My beloved, don't mention her anymore, it's disappointing."

    Ye Xianyue took the opportunity to hold Qin Ran's hand, with a hint of resentment in her charming eyes.

    "Okay, okay, your majesty doesn't like it, I just don't mention it."

    "Then which sister is your Majesty planning to bestow your favor on next? Sister Xiangxiang? Or the most beautiful sister Guanguan in Great Xia?"

    "If Your Majesty has made a decision, he must tell me in advance, so that I can prepare gifts as a congratulatory gift in advance~~"

    These words were sour.

    Qin Ran smiled secretly in his heart and threw a delicate box into Ye Xianyue's arms.

    "What my concubine said is absolutely true. You really need to prepare some congratulatory gifts to avoid being misled by other concubines in the future."

    "My beloved, look, can the contents of this box be used as a gift?"

    Ye Xianyue opened the box doubtfully.

    Suddenly, a warmth that penetrated straight into his soul spread, and the cold air in the palace was dissipated.

    "This is..."

    Ye Xianyue stared at the jade pendant in the box intently, her delicate body trembling slightly, and her purple eyes filled with infinite tenderness.

    Qin Ran smiled frivolously, "This is the Phoenix Soul Warm Jade, which has a trace of the true soul of the Fire Phoenix, which can dispel the coldness in the world."

    "My beloved, what do you think of this piece of jade as a gift?"

    Ye Xianyue held the jade pendant tightly in her hands and rolled her eyes at Qin Ran dissatisfied.

    "This jade belongs to my concubine~"

    "Oh."

    Qin Ran smiled playfully.

    Ye Xianyue played with the jade pendant, and there was a warmth around her, making her cold face become a little rosy.

    She placed the jade pendant gently against her chest. After a moment of silence, there was a rare seriousness in her enchanting purple eyes.

    "Your Majesty, have you ever thought about dedicating yourself to cultivation and regaining the glory of the Imperial Yun Family?"

    Qin Ran was shocked when he heard this.

    The efforts of the past few days have indeed been in vain, Ye Xianyue's reminder has shown a change in his attitude.
title_en: Chapter 18 He is really a playboy who cannot be helped
